svg.title: M-04 Parts and Cut Schedule - Tape Measure Satellite Yagi
svg.desc: Rev B installed-parts cut schedule and steel-stock allocation derived from O3-O6 Rev L. Dimensions and tolerances control.
svg.text: FOR REVIEW - SOURCE O3-O6 REV L
APPROX. 3/8 in WIDE CONDUCTIVE TAPE STEEL
Each row is one finished cut; dimensions do not include the driven-element gap.
Driven half mismatch max: 2 m 0.03125 in; 70 cm 0.0156 in.
Driven tip gaps and installed tip-to-tip spans are controlled on M-06.
Measure after deburring and label every piece immediately.
Installed pieces shown; procurement stock and spare quantities follow O4.
Keep one continuous 41.400 in section until cut inspection passes.
23.900 in covers losses; obtain more stock if exceeded.
PROPORTIONAL ALLOCATION ONLY; NOT A CUT ORDER.
1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN INCHES; QUANTITIES ARE INSTALLED FINISHED PARTS.
2. PAD PLAN DIMENSIONS MINIMUM; INSTALLED THICKNESS >= 0.375 in.
3. O7 HAIRPIN BLANK AND COAX CUTS ARE EXCLUDED FROM THIS O6 SCHEDULE.
